definitions.explanation: An organ involved in digesting food, such as the stomach and intestines. Together they form the digestive system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{消化|しょうか}{器官|きかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The stomach is one of the digestive organs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、{消化|しょうか}{器官|きかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Lately my digestive organs have not been in good shape.

examples.japanese: ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧かん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{消化|しょうか}{器官|きかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: Chewing food well helps reduce the burden on the digestive organs.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧ (digestion) + ⟦{器官|きかん}→器官：02685_kikan⟧ (organ). Refers to the organs that process food, including the stomach, intestines, and liver.
